turns.sql:
SELECT
    name,
    power,
    toughness,
    convertedManaCost,
    rarity,
    (
        CASE WHEN power GLOB '-?[0-9]+' THEN CAST(power AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN toughness GLOB '-?[0-9]+' THEN CAST(toughness AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END +
        COALESCE(convertedManaCost, 0) +
        CASE
            WHEN keywords IS NULL OR keywords = '' THEN 0
            ELSE (LENGTH(keywords) - LENGTH(REPLACE(keywords, ',', '')) + 1)
        END +
        CASE rarity
            WHEN 'common' THEN 1
            WHEN 'uncommon' THEN 2
            WHEN 'rare' THEN 3
            WHEN 'mythic' THEN 4
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS competitiveness_score,
    CASE
        WHEN (
            CASE WHEN power GLOB '-?[0-9]+' THEN CAST(power AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN toughness GLOB '-?[0-9]+' THEN CAST(toughness AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END +
            COALESCE(convertedManaCost, 0) +
            CASE
                WHEN keywords IS NULL OR keywords = '' THEN 0
                ELSE (LENGTH(keywords) - LENGTH(REPLACE(keywords, ',', '')) + 1)
            END +
            CASE rarity
                WHEN 'common' THEN 1
                WHEN 'uncommon' THEN 2
                WHEN 'rare' THEN 3
                WHEN 'mythic' THEN 4
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) <= 33 THEN 'Beginner'
        WHEN (
            CASE WHEN power GLOB '-?[0-9]+' THEN CAST(power AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN toughness GLOB '-?[0-9]+' THEN CAST(toughness AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END +
            COALESCE(convertedManaCost, 0) +
            CASE
                WHEN keywords IS NULL OR keywords = '' THEN 0
                ELSE (LENGTH(keywords) - LENGTH(REPLACE(keywords, ',', '')) + 1)
            END +
            CASE rarity
                WHEN 'common' THEN 1
                WHEN 'uncommon' THEN 2
                WHEN 'rare' THEN 3
                WHEN 'mythic' THEN 4
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) <= 66 THEN 'Intermediate'
        ELSE 'Expert'
    END AS tier
FROM cards
WHERE type LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND supertypes LIKE '%Legendary%';
